page.overview:
What is Nahel bond?

The Nahel bond is a symbiotic bond between humans and certain types of spren. It is a mutually beneficent relationship that gives the spren a stronger presence in the Physical Realm and the ability to think and remember more clearly in that Realm.

Presumably, it also grants the person bound to the spren a stronger presence in the Cognitive Realm, allowing her/him to manipulate Stormlight more potently, as does Lift. The Nahel bond has been known of since the Heraldic Epochs.

Category:Magic Systems Category:Cosmere Category:The Stormlight Archive
